verification.method: scripts/verify/dr-congo.py reads the original UN files directly (not the site's generated data) and compares them with the built page, JSON-LD and CSV; the build itself fails if any sentence-level claim (assertClaim) stops being true; then a hand read of title, description, headline, FAQ and story text.
what: Population 1950–2100, rank 2026/2050/2100, share, growth (top three among countries over 10 million), density, land area

Fourth-largest yearly addition (after India, Nigeria, Pakistan); births, deaths; growth from births

Fourth in Africa, largest in Middle Africa; 9.5 times 1950; urban share; title, meta description, headline, FAQ JSON-LD, CSV rows, live counter
